audit.why: full phases[N].side and content win[N] agree row for row and match the packet: Cassiopeia 1-3, Skill at 4-5, Master Yi at 6 and first item, Cassiopeia at 2+ items.

audit.whatIsWrong: The content spikes carry no cooldowns at all.
audit.why: Miasma is 24/22/20/18/16s and is the single gate on your all-in; Petrifying Gaze is 120/100/80s against Highlander's flat 85s; Twin Fang is a 0.75s spam and Noxious Blast 3.5s, which is why you cannot win a poke war.
audit.corrected: spikes[0..2] now carry the W, R, Q and E timers.

audit.whatIsWrong: The content layer calls Miasma a 'slow-zone' throughout and never mentions grounding. Grounding is the decisive interaction in this matchup: grounded enemies cannot use movement abilities, so Alpha Strike will not cast at all. The full layer already states this; the content layer contradicts it by implying Alpha Strike works through her W. Meditate is also never flagged as breakable by Petrifying Gaze.
audit.why: A player who thinks W only slows will press Alpha Strike inside the cloud, get nothing, and die with no escape.
audit.corrected: Miasma (W) slows AND grounds — inside it Alpha Strike does not cast, and Highlander's slow immunity does not answer grounding, only the slow. Petrifying Gaze (R) stuns enemies facing her and slows those facing away, and it cancels Meditate. Twin Fang (E) heals her off poisoned targets.

audit.whatIsWrong: Grievous Wounds appears nowhere in the content layer.
audit.why: Twin Fang heals a percentage of damage dealt on a 0.75s cooldown — the extended fights you want are exactly what it beats.
audit.corrected: Anti-heal named in spikes[0].text and spikes[2].text.

edits.before: Cassiopeia pokes you flat with Q (Noxious Blast) and layers W (Miasma) to slow you and deny your all-in, while her E (Twin Fang) spam-heals and chunks you if you're poisoned. Do not walk through her W; sidestep her Q and farm at range because you can't trade back yet.
edits.after: Cassiopeia pokes with Noxious Blast (Q, 3.5s) and lays Miasma (W, 24s at rank 1), which GROUNDS you — inside it Alpha Strike will not cast at all. Twin Fang (E, 0.75s) heals her off poisoned targets, so buy Grievous Wounds and farm outside the clouds.

edits.before: Your Highlander is up and it tilts your way — as long as you don't look at her, you can Q Alpha Strike onto her since the untargetable dash dodges her Q and E. Her R (Petrifying Gaze) only stuns if you're facing her, so turn away before you engage.
edits.after: Highlander (85s) tilts it your way: slow immunity ignores her Miasma slow, though the grounding still blocks Alpha Strike. Petrifying Gaze (R, 120s at rank 1) stuns only enemies facing her — and it breaks any Meditate you are channelling.

edits.before: With Wuju Style and Berserker's you out-DPS her once you're stuck on her; her only defence is kiting through W poison, so time Q to close the gap after her R and burn her through Meditate.
edits.after: With Wuju Style and Berserker's you out-DPS her once you're stuck on her, provided Grievous Wounds is cutting Twin Fang. Close after Miasma is spent (24s at rank 1); grounded, Alpha Strike does not exist.

edits.before: At 2 her W slow-zone denies your engage and keeps her ahead.
edits.after: At 2 Miasma grounds you, denying Alpha Strike entirely.

edits.before: At 5 your Highlander and Q dash dodge her spells and tilt fights to you.
edits.after: At 6 Highlander's slow immunity beats her kite and tilts fights to you.

edits.before: By level 4 it evens, and at 6 your Highlander and Q dash — which dodges her Q and E — tilt duels your way if you turn away from her R.
edits.after: By level 4 it evens, and at 6 Highlander's slow immunity beats her kite, but Miasma still grounds Alpha Strike — commit once her W is spent.

edits.before: Late she scales back into it: her R AoE stun and W zone control lock you the moment you facecheck, so approach off-angle or she petrifies and kites you.
edits.after: Late she scales back: Petrifying Gaze stuns you if you are facing her and Miasma grounds your escape, so hold Alpha Strike for after her W, not before.

edits.before: Poke with Q and layer W to slow and deny your engage
edits.after: Poke with Q and ground your Alpha Strike with Miasma

edits.before: Stay off her W Miasma poison zones while approaching
edits.after: Stay out of Miasma — grounded, you cannot Alpha Strike

notes: The content layer described Miasma as a slow and told the player to Alpha Strike through it; the full layer correctly says the grounding cancels the dash. Corrected toward the full layer. Note that Highlander's slow immunity does NOT answer grounding — the two are separate, and the page previously blurred them. Left unwritten because the kits cannot settle it: whether Petrifying Gaze checks facing at cast time or at hit time, which would change whether turning mid-cast helps.
